videos.title: Christmas With a Prince: The Royal Baby
videos.description: Things get complicated for expectant Prince Alexander and Dr Tasha when a Royal State Visit, passing through her hometown, is planned abroad. The couple struggles to balance defying tradition while literally delivering on expectations.

videos.description: Princess Camille travels to America to create a college exchange programme and falls for a handsome professor. When she discovers he was hired by her father to watch out for her, she wonders if he cares more about her or his career.

videos.title: Memories of Christmas
videos.description: When Noelle inherits her mother's house, she finds out that for the past few years her ageing mother had been hiring professionals to decorate it for Christmas. Noelle tells the decorator that the deal is off, but he refuses to take no for an answer.

videos.title: Six Degrees of Santa
videos.description: Believing she may be his soul mate, a leading internet entrepreneur searches for the mystery woman whose Christmas gift wound up in his hands.

videos.title: Christmas Tree Lane
videos.description: When music store owner Meg spearheads community efforts to save her street from demolition, she is shocked to find out that the man she's falling for is working for the company that she is fighting.

videos.title: A Very Merry Bridesmaid
videos.description: Leah's 30th birthday is on Christmas Eve, the same day as her brother's wedding. Her childhood crush is back in town for the ceremony, and he's determined to make sure her special day doesn't go by the wayside.

videos.title: Chateau Christmas
videos.description: A world-renowned pianist rediscovers her passion for music after reuniting with her ex during the holidays.

videos.title: A Winter's Song
videos.description: A festive musical romance with Jessie Bedrossian. A struggling musician travels to her father's homeland of Armenia, where its culture and music spark a life-changing self-discovery.

videos.title: A Belgian Chocolate Christmas
videos.description: A photographer takes her best friend's place at a Belgian culinary school during the holidays and connects with the chocolatier leading the class. A case of mistaken identity impacts their blossoming romance.

videos.title: A Gingerbread Romance
videos.description: A young architect teams up with a chef to enter a contest to design a life-sized gingerbread house.

videos.title: A Christmas Break
videos.description: An unexpected romance develops between a single mother and a Hollywood actor as they work together to stop a town's school from closing right before Christmas Eve.
